- Overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after sharp spikes; reduce initial forecast values by 5–10%.
- Underestimate during prolonged downward trends; increase forecast by 3–7% to account for mean reversion.
- Overshoot after high volatility periods; apply a 1–3 day lag correction to avoid overreacting to recent spikes.
- Model tends to underestimate true outcomes in the 10–15 day horizon; add 2–5% to forecast for longer-term bias.
- Avoid overfitting to recent history; reduce weight on last 5–7 days when true outcomes deviate significantly from model trend.
